sources.title: Marine Corps Base Strengthens Wildfire Response With Drones

en.title: U.S. Marine Corps Base Deploys Drones for Wildfire Response
en.dek: Marine Corps Base Camp Pendleton announced advanced drone deployment to monitor and aid firefighting on 30 October 2026.
facts: U.S. Department of War announced deployment of advanced drones at Camp Pendleton.
Drones will monitor and assist in firefighting operations.
Camp Pendleton is a Marine Corps installation.
body: The U.S. Department of War announced that Marine Corps Base Camp Pendleton has deployed advanced drone technology to monitor and assist in firefighting operations, and the announcement was made on 30 October 2026.
According to the press release, the drones will provide real‑time aerial surveillance and enable rapid assessment of fire spread, helping guide ground crews and identify fire hotspots.
The U.S. Department of War did not specify the drone model, and the base is a Marine Corps installation.
en.context: The U.S. Department of War announced that Camp Pendleton has strengthened its wildfire response capabilities by deploying advanced drone technology to monitor and assist in firefighting operations.
